description.fun: Snubbull looks fierce, with its bulldog underbite and threatening growl, but it's timid, playful and affectionate, and it's said to be saddened when others run from its scary face. Its pink fur and dress-like folds of skin may poke fun at pampered pet dogs dressed up by their owners. It was a Normal type until Generation 6 made it a Fairy, matching its long-standing 'Fairy Pokémon' category.
description.guide: A Fairy-type, bulldog-like Pokémon (a Normal type before Generation 6) with pink fur and a pronounced underbite. Despite its intimidating face it is timid and affectionate. It evolves into Granbull at level 23.
description.tagline: A scary-faced pink bulldog that just wants to be loved

description.fun: Granbull's lower jaw is so heavy that it has to keep its head tilted down for balance, and those big fangs give it a fearsome bite. Yet it's even more timid than Snubbull, rarely bites unless startled, and flails about when attacked, which is why it's considered too faint-hearted to make a good guard dog. Its name mixes grand, grumble and bulldog.
description.guide: A Fairy-type bulldog Pokémon (a Normal type before Generation 6), the evolution of Snubbull. Its heavy lower jaw and fangs give it a powerful bite, but it is timid and avoids fights.
description.tagline: A big-jawed bulldog that's far too timid to guard anything
